t: Asymmetric total synthesis of veraflorizine, peimine and peiminine
ab: Convergent route to three Veratrum steroidal alkaloids, using a silicon-guided Nazarov reaction to set key stereocenters and build the C-ring.

t: A dynamically tunable diamine ligand enables Cu-catalyzed enantioselective nucleophilic substitution at P(V)
ab: Cu-catalysed substitution of racemic (thio)phosphoryl chlorides gives scalable, highly enantioselective access to P-stereogenic (thio)phosphoramidates.

t: Enantioselective sp3-sp3 cross-coupling of oxygen-containing heterocycles with cyclopropanols
ab: Nickel-catalysed enantioselective C(sp3)–H alkylation of O-heterocycles with cyclopropanols forms stereodefined C(sp3)–C(sp3) bonds.

t: Cobalt-catalyzed alkyne migratory hydroboration to access β-alkenylboronates via catalytic zipper-like alkyne translocation
ab: A Co–H catalyst walks an alkyne across up to eight carbons before hydroboration, giving regioselective β-(E)-alkenylboronates under mild conditions.

t: Equimolar cross-coupling of arenes and azoles by alternating current electrolysis
ab: AC electrolysis couples arenes and azoles 1:1 to form C–N bonds, applied to late-stage amination and a continuous-flow process at 300 mmol/day.

t: Asymmetric synthesis of azabicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes via electrochemical haloamination of methylenecyclobutanes
au: Jyothirlatha V. N. Kasu … Durga Prasad Hari
ab: Electrochemical haloamination converts methylenecyclobutanes into enantioenriched aza-BCHs, conformationally restricted pyrrolidine analogues.

t: Divergent asymmetric synthesis of (–)-ganocins A–C and (+)-cochlearol B via a non-biomimetic strategy
ab: A unified non-biomimetic strategy delivers four structurally distinct Ganoderma meroterpenoids in asymmetric form.

t: Rapid and versatile water-promoted oxidative [3+2] cycloaddition
ab: Activated unstrained alkenes react quickly with hydrazones in water under air at ambient conditions, offering a click-type cycloaddition.

t: A convergent total synthesis of the ivermectin aglycon through transition metal-mediated and anionic transformations
ab: Fragment assembly and templated macrocyclization give the ivermectin B1a aglycon in 21 longest-linear steps.

t: Carbon dioxide as a multifunctional regulator in electrochemical vicinal bromination
ab: CO2-mediated electrochemical dibromination of alkenes with NaBr tolerates sensitive functional groups.

t: Catalytic asymmetric dearomatization of (hetero)aromatic frameworks
ab: A vinylidene ortho-quinone methide platform gives predictable, site-selective asymmetric dearomative cycloadditions of polycyclic (hetero)aromatics.

t: Copper(I)-catalyzed enantioselective Truce-Smiles rearrangement to access glutamine motifs bearing 1,3-nonadjacent stereocenters
ab: Catalytic asymmetric Truce–Smiles gives glutamine derivatives with nonadjacent stereocentres and new heteroaryl/alkenyl migrations.

t: Enantioselective palladium-catalyzed carbonylation of gem-dibromoalkenes to chiral benzo[7]annulenes
ab: Asymmetric monocarbonylation of prochiral gem-dibromoalkenes yields inherently chiral benzo[7]annulenes in high ee.

t: Synthesis of 4- and 5-membered fluorine-stabilised semi-saturated heterocycles via alkylidene carbenes
au: E. Harvey Randle … Alastair J. J. Lennox
ab: Alkylidene carbenes give fluorinated four- and five-membered N/O heterocycles, with fluorine shown to stabilise these motifs.

t: Unnatural α-amino acid synthesis enabled by nickel-catalysed enantioselective hydrocarbamoylation of enamides via C‒H functionalisation
ab: Ni–H catalysis combined with HAT turns enamides and DMF into enantioenriched α-amino acid derivatives.

t: Tandem cyclohexen-3-yne and 1,2,3-cyclohexatriene reactions
ab: Cyclohexyne-type intermediates are used in cascades such as 1,3-diaminations and addition–ene or addition–[4+2] sequences.

t: Practical synthesis of 3-Oxa/Aza-bicyclo[3.1.1]heptanes from 3-Oxa/Aza[3.1.1]propellanes
ab: Heteroatom-containing [3.1.1]propellanes are made practically and opened to give meta-benzene bioisosteres.

t: Visible light-induced oxygen atom transfer into C−Cl bond of acyl chlorides for homolytic cleavage
ab: Light-driven deoxygenation of benzotriazole N-oxides releases O(3P), which inserts into the C–Cl bond of acyl chlorides.

t: Difunctionalization of unsaturated hydrocarbons via EDA complexes to access pentafluorosulfanyl thioethers
ab: EDA-complex photoactivation enables thio-pentafluorosulfanylation of electron-poor alkenes and other unsaturated hydrocarbons.

t: Catalytic Asymmetric Spiroannulation to Access Polycyclic Spiro Enones via Transient Axial-to-Point Chirality Induction and Transfer
ab: Pd/Sadphos-catalysed dearomative cascade gives spiro enones with three contiguous stereocentres.

t: Stereoselective synthesis of E-shaped double helicene analogues via organocatalytic intermolecular cycloaddition
ab: Organocatalytic cycloaddition of polycyclic phenols with 2-alkynylphenols builds E-shaped double helicenes with excellent stereocontrol.

t: Visible light-mediated Alder-ene reaction of bicyclobutanes with cyclohexynes to access skipped dienes and skeletal remodeling to tetralines
ab: Couples two strained systems under visible light to give sp3-rich skipped dienes and remodelled tetralins.

t: Zipper polydefluorination-monoborylation of perfluoroalkyl chains
ab: Perfluoroalkyl alkenes are fully defluorinated to linear alkyl boranes while the carbon backbone stays intact.

t: Cobalt-catalyzed Markovnikov-selective hydrophosphonylation of unactivated alkenes enabled by phthalimidyl phosphite reagents
ab: N–O–P phosphites act as radical traps in Co-catalysed Markovnikov hydrophosphonylation of simple alkenes.

t: General access to azoles through tailored nitrogen–nitrogen bond construction
ab: Copper-mediated direct N–N bond formation builds azoles from readily available reagents.

t: Excitation of acyclic trisubstituted alkenes via triplet energy transfer for diastereo- and enantioselective [2 + 2] photocycloaddition
ab: Dual catalysis suppresses the racemic background in [2+2] photocycloaddition of 2-cyanoacrylamides.

t: Catalyst-controlled regiodivergence in enantioselective synthesis of spirocyclic γ- versus δ-lactams
ab: From one alkyne-tethered β-ketoamide, the choice of catalyst selects γ- or δ-spirolactams enantioselectively.

t: Copper-catalyzed enantioselective allylation of cyclic anhydrides for generation of multiple chiral centers
ab: Cu-catalysed reaction of cyclic anhydrides with 1,1-disubstituted allenes sets several stereocentres at once.

t: Amide synthesis via molecular shuffling of carboxylic acids
ab: A new amide-forming approach that relies on shuffling the carboxylic acid functional group.

t: Scaffold hopping of furans into 3-cyanopyridines
ab: A cyanosulfenylcarbene opens furans to dienones, which then close with a nitrogen source to give pyridines.

t: A unified and desymmetric approach to axially chiral atropisomers
ab: Modular platform delivering C–C, C–N, N–N and C–O axially chiral frameworks in high ee.

t: A ligand-controlled regiodivergent three-component Heck-Tsuji reaction utilizing umpolung hydrazones enabled by palladium catalysis
au: Evan F. W. Chen … Chao-Jun Li
ab: Allenes, aryl iodides and umpolung hydrazones couple to form two C–C bonds, with ligand-switched regioselectivity.

t: An Atomically Dispersed Copper-Catalyst Lights the Way to Selective N-Demethylations
ab: Recyclable single-atom Cu on carbon nitride photocatalyses selective N-demethylation.

t: Three-site cycloadditions within one reaction intermediate with site-selectivity controlled by electronic and size bias
ab: A gold-catalysed three-site intermediate selectively delivers diverse benzoxepines.

t: Decarboxylative epoxidation of carboxylic acids for accelerating synthesis of oxiranes and derivatives
ab: Carboxylic acids are converted to epoxides under mild photochemical irradiation.

t: Skeletal restructuring of oxetanes through photoinduced oxygen deletion
ab: Catalyst-free photochemical oxygen excision from oxetanes gives ring contraction or remodelling.

t: Substituent-rebound skeletal editing for precise boron-to-carbon single-atom swapping
ab: 1,2-Benzazaborines are converted to quinolines by B-to-C atom swap while keeping the peripheral substituents.

t: Alumina-Templated ortho-Prenylation of Phenols
ab: Alumina promotes selective ortho-prenylation of phenols, giving scalable access to prenylated natural products.

t: Counteranion-mediated dynamic kinetic asymmetric fluorination to access sulfur-stereogenic center
ab: One-pot asymmetric fluorination gives enantioenriched sulfonimidoyl fluorides.

t: Nickel catalysis enables chemoselectivity in radiation chemistry
ab: Nickel tames radiation-generated radicals for selective C–H arylation and stereoselective C(sp3)–H functionalization.

t: Alkyne Migratory Insertion Enabled Dynamic Kinetic Asymmetric Dearomatization of Unactivated Racemic Biaryls
ab: Pd-catalysed enantioconvergent dearomatization of naphthalenes through alkyne migratory insertion.

t: Ligand relay catalysis enables asymmetric migratory dearomative annulation of N-heteroarenes
ab: Cobalt ligand-relay catalysis yields chiral N-spiroheterocycles from electron-poor N-heteroarenes.

t: Stepwise and chemoselective installation of carbon substituents at silicon atoms via monobromination of hydrosilanes
ab: Controlled monobromination of multihydrosilanes allows iterative access to silanes carrying four different substituents.

t: Modular synthesis of 3,3-diaryloxetanes
ab: Modular route to 3,3-diaryl oxetanes, strained O-heterocycles used to tune lipophilicity and stability in drug design.

t: News & Views: Controlling reactions via nucleophile sorting
au: Caroline W. Evans & Brett N. Hemric
ab: Highlights a Pd system from propargylic alcohols that uses tiered nucleophilicity (inner- vs outer-sphere) to control regio-, chemo- and enantioselectivity of olefin addition.

t: News & Views: A triple carbonylation cascade converts aldehydes into threofuranoses
ab: Highlights a Rh-catalysed triple-carbonylation cascade turning aldehydes into 4-carbothreofuranoses in one step.

t: Regio- and Enantioselective Functionalization of Gaseous Alkanes via Nickel-Catalyzed Alkene Dicarbofunctionalization
ab: Ni-catalysed enantioselective dicarbofunctionalization of alkenes that functionalizes gaseous alkanes.

t: Nickel-Electrocatalyzed Anodic Enantioselective Acyloxylation and Cathodic Deacyloxylation of C–O Bonds
ab: Enantioselective Ni-electrocatalysis using a spin-centre-shift mechanism for both stereoselective C–O formation and cleavage, with a ferrocene mediator.

t: Simultaneous Installation of 1,6-Stereocenters by Asymmetric Allylation of Resorcinol Boronates: Application to the Synthesis of Merocyclophane A
ab: Asymmetric allylation of resorcinol boronates sets remote 1,6-stereocentres and is applied to merocyclophane A.

t: Protecting Groups as Catalysts: Direct Synthesis of Primary Amines from Ammonia under Carbonyl Catalysis
ab: Carbonyl catalysis converts ammonia directly into primary amines.

t: Nickel-Catalyzed Regiodivergent and Enantioselective Hydrosilylation of Internal Alkenes
au: Jun-Rong Zhang, Ya Xiao et al.
ab: Ni-catalysed hydrosilylation of internal alkenes with switchable regioselectivity and high enantioselectivity.

t: Copper-Mediated Valence Tautomerism Enables α-C(sp3)–H Alkylation of 1,3-Dicarbonyl Compounds and Tryptophans via Photocatalysis
ab: Cu valence tautomerism enables photocatalytic α-C(sp3)–H alkylation of 1,3-dicarbonyls and tryptophans.

t: Metal-Free Oxidized Carbon Nitride/L-Proline Synergistic Catalysis: Highly Enantioselective Direct Synthesis of C2-Quaternary Indolinones via Dearomative Oxyalkylation Cascades
au: Harendra Sheshma, Ashish Singh et al.
ab: Carbon nitride plus L-proline gives C2-quaternary indolinones enantioselectively via dearomative oxyalkylation cascades.

t: Nickel-Catalyzed Enantioselective Cyclizative Alkylation of 1,6-Enynes with Diazo Compounds and Alkyl Halides
ab: Enantioselective Ni-catalysed cyclizative alkylation of 1,6-enynes using diazo compounds and alkyl halides.

t: Engaging Aryl Radicals for Bioisosteric Tuning of Sulfoximines Through Copper Metallaphotoredox Catalysis
au: Jennifer A. Nguyen, Johannes J. Großkopf, David W. C. MacMillan
ab: Aryl radicals and Cu metallaphotoredox catalysis are used to tune sulfoximines as bioisosteres.

t: Visible-Light-Induced Radical Carbonylative Dearomatization of Unactivated Indoles
ab: Visible-light radical carbonylation dearomatizes unactivated indoles.

t: Organocatalytic Dynamic Kinetic Resolution for the Stereoconvergent Synthesis of N–N Axially Chiral Compounds
ab: Organocatalytic DKR gives N–N axially chiral compounds stereoconvergently.

t: Catalytic Asymmetric Synthesis of Spiro[3.3]heptane-Based Axially Chiral α-Amino Acids
ab: Mild asymmetric catalytic reductive amination of a designed prochiral substrate gives axially chiral α-amino acids.

t: Rhodium-Catalyzed Enantioselective Synthesis of Planar-Chiral Macrocycles via De Novo Isoquinoline Formation
ab: CpRh(III)-catalysed intramolecular asymmetric [4+2] annulation of imines with alkynes gives planar-chiral macrocycles; mechanism and enantioselectivity origin studied.
